title: Lester and the clarinet and soprano in his father's band
summary: Lester did not really play clarinet until Basie; he took solos on soprano, and Ben Wilkerson was the clarinettist.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: So let me ask you this quick question about the clarinet. When Lester was playing clarinet in the family dance band, was he taking solos on clarinet?
No, he wasn't playing no clarinet.
Oh, he was playing the clarinet. I thought you said he had one in the family group.

Well, this was in the dance band that he had a clarinet. But he had a clarinet with keys on it. It didn't have no holes. And his father gave him hell. He said, 'You don't want that. You want a clarinet with some holes on it' -- finger holes. He said, 'You're playing that just like you play that saxophone.' But that's the first person I ever seen like that.
So he didn't play clarinet, you're saying.
He didn't start to really playing clarinet
I see. So he wasn't playing clarinet back then.

No. He used to play that soprano all the time. That's what he used to take his solos on. All of them had sopranos, he and Clyde both had sopranos. But the other guy, we called him Bo -- Ben Wilkerson -- he had a clarinet. He was a good clarinet player. He could play nice clarinet.
That was in the family dance band.
No, there wasn't no family in that dance band.
Well, I mean, Lester Young's father's dance band.
